choose.when: insert into wf_deploy_dmn_snapshot (deploy_id, process_key, element_id, source_decision_id, decision_key, decision_version, source_deployment_id, resource_name, resource_checksum, frozen_deployment_id, frozen_decision_id, snapshot_checksum, create_by, create_time) values (#{item.deployId}, #{item.processKey}, #{item.elementId}, #{item.sourceDecisionId}, #{item.decisionKey}, #{item.decisionVersion}, #{item.sourceDeploymentId}, #{item.resourceName}, #{item.resourceChecksum}, #{item.frozenDeploymentId}, #{item.frozenDecisionId}, #{item.snapshotChecksum}, #{item.createBy}, current_timestamp(3))
choose.otherwise: insert into wf_deploy_dmn_snapshot (deploy_id, process_key, element_id, source_decision_id, decision_key, decision_version, source_deployment_id, resource_name, resource_checksum, frozen_deployment_id, frozen_decision_id, snapshot_checksum, create_by, create_time) select '', '', '', '', '', 1, '', '', repeat('0', 64), '', '', repeat('0', 64), '', current_timestamp(3) where 1 = 0

mapper.select: select snapshot_id, deploy_id, process_key, element_id, source_decision_id, decision_key, decision_version, source_deployment_id, resource_name, resource_checksum, frozen_deployment_id, frozen_decision_id, snapshot_checksum, create_by, create_time from wf_deploy_dmn_snapshot where deploy_id = #{deployId} order by process_key, element_id
select count(*) from wf_deploy_dmn_snapshot where source_deployment_id = #{sourceDeploymentId}
